rdfs:label: PersonalProfileDocument
rdfs:comment: An RDF document that describes its own author — its maker is also its primaryTopic; the classic FOAF / WebID profile document.
notes: Subclass of `urn:solid:Document`. The document's `foaf:primaryTopic` is the Person it describes. WebID profile documents are typically of this type. The relationship between the document and its subject Person is asymmetric: one document, one primary topic. For documents about a person written by someone else, use `urn:solid:Document` with `urn:solid:primaryTopic`.

history.note: Comment states the maker-is-primaryTopic constraint; replaced unrelated seeAlso; notes cover third-party bios; example uses urn:solid:primaryTopic.
